parameters.content:
## Setup
1. **Settings**: six Gemini and six Qwen voice IDs, LiteLLM endpoints, Bunny storage and CDN URLs. Check ghostUrl.
2. Credentials (Templated Custom Auth): **qwen-tts** and **gemini-tts** use {"headers":{"Authorization":"Bearer {{api_key}}"}}. **Upload to Bunny** uses {"headers":{"AccessKey":"{{api_key}}"}} with the storage-zone password.
3. Qwen is primary and returns MP3. A quota/allocation/balance error regenerates the complete article in Gemini WAV; other Qwen errors stop the workflow. Mixed MP3/WAV chunks are never joined.
4. Ghost Admin webhooks: Post published and Published post updated → production URL of **Ghost Webhook**, with event=published or event=edited and the configured shared secret. Manual Test bypasses validation.
5. Tags: #audio opts in; #audio-refresh regenerates; #lang-es or an -es slug selects Spanish. Voice remains stable through hash(post.id).

Before synthesis, one HEAD request checks the deterministic Qwen MP3 URL. Existing files skip TTS and Bunny, then update only the Ghost card; #audio-refresh bypasses this check and versions the URL from the previous card to avoid stale CDN/browser audio. Both .mp3 and .wav cards are recognized as current.

Test one published post first: set its slug in **Test Post**, bind LiteLLM/Bunny credentials, run **Manual Test**, then inspect the audio card and CDN. Existing published posts require a separate controlled backlog run; webhooks only cover future events.

nodes.notes: Why Code: Gemini returns base64 WAV inside JSON; native nodes cannot validate and decode all chunks into binary data in one step.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { model: $('Settings').first().json.qwenModel, input: { text: $json.text, voice: $json.qwenVoice, format: 'mp3', sample_rate: 24000, language_hints: [$json.language], instruction: $json.qwenInstruction, seed: 42 } } }}

parameters.jsCode:
// A mid-article quota failure restarts every chunk in Gemini to avoid mixed audio formats.
return $('Plan Audio').all().map(item => ({ json: { ...item.json, fallbackFromQwen: true }, pairedItem: item.pairedItem }));

const current = $('chunk-loop').first().json;
return [{ json: { ...current, ...$input.first().json } }];

const plan = $('restore-cached-plan').item.json;
return { json: { ...plan }, binary: $input.item.binary };

const plan = $('restore-gemini-plan').item.json;
return { json: { ...plan, ...$input.item.json } };

nodeGroups.name: Read & plan
nodeGroups.description: Loads the post's lexical, fingerprints its text and decides: new audio, refresh, mark stale, or stop.

nodeGroups.name: Write to Ghost
nodeGroups.description: Re-reads the post, inserts or replaces the audio card (or retitles it as stale) and saves.

nodeGroups.name: Generate audio
nodeGroups.description: Reuses semantic chunks, restores metadata across HTTP nodes, synthesizes missing audio and publishes ordered audio with cue manifest.

activeVersion.name: Skip TTS for non-public posts
activeVersion.description: Security fix F1: Plan Audio now returns no items unless post.visibility is 'public', so members-only, paid and tier posts are never narrated, uploaded to the public CDN, or given an audio card above the paywall.
